Ingredients: * 2 cups fresh or frozen cherries, pitted * 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar * 1/2 cup all-purpose flour * 1/2 teaspoon baking powder * 1/2 teaspoon salt * 1/2 cup whole milk * 2 large eggs * 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Instructions: 1. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the clafoutis is puffed and golden brown. 7.
